query:
SELECT 
  cp.id,
  cp.userId,
  cp.tenantId,
  cp.segment,
  cp.city,
  cp.status,
  cp.createdAt,
  u.email,
  t.name as tenantName
FROM commercialPointRequests cp
LEFT JOIN users u ON cp.userId = u.id
LEFT JOIN tenants t ON cp.tenantId = t.id
WHERE u.email = 'davicristianodeandrade4@gmail.com'
ORDER BY cp.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 10;
